label: Uneasy calm
summary: The US land blockade of Iran is now in effect, Trump says, though he called renewed strikes unlikely if talks on the nuclear programme and Hormuz progress, and expects to raise the war with Xi and Putin at APEC. A drone strike halted output at Iraq's Khor Mor gasfield. Asian markets rebounded sharply after last week's tech rout. COP31 opens in Antalya with a narrower agenda and no US delegation. A train collision near Cairo killed seven. Brighter notes: Mexico arrested an alleged senior Jalisco cartel leader, Moldova opened a power line to Romania to cut reliance on Russia, Germany's Merz will nominate Ilse Aigner as the first woman president, and Pope Leo was welcomed in Argentina. A large study tied a stronger flu shot to lower Alzheimer's risk. The weighted formula gave 45; no editorial adjustment.
